data.body: SYSTEMIC FINDING (basilisk, 2026-08-13): the _config_schema.py 808/800 breach on main was EMERGENT — three independent changes (+7, +9, +8 lines) each green against its own base, combined by Gerrit Rebase-If-Necessary at submit into a tree no per-change CI ever tested. This is the semantic-conflict class the ADR-0025 post-ADR-0047 note warns about for rebase-at-submit; the absolute module-size cap acted as the detector (a ratchet keyed to per-change deltas would have missed it). Evidence for any future review of the Rebase-If-Necessary policy: near-cap files turn every concurrent landing into a potential emergent breach — one more argument for the operator's near-cap remediation lane keeping headroom ≥ fleet concurrency × typical delta.
